meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能通过 Slack 收发消息:在频道或私聊中回应你,并用 Slack 的 mrkdwn 语法正确排版消息。
howto.when: 当你提出要接入或配置 Slack 频道,或在 /setup 流程进行到渠道添加时,该技能开始执行。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 频道接进来,用 Socket Mode。
say.note: 技能会走无需公网地址的接入方式。

say.text: 用 webhook 方式接入 Slack,告诉我需要准备什么公网地址。
say.note: 会引导你创建应用并填入相应凭据。

say.text: Slack 接入完成了吗?往我的私聊发条测试消息。
say.note: 会先解析 Slack 成员 ID,重启服务后发送。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can send and receive messages through Slack channels or DMs, and applies Slack's mrkdwn syntax so message formatting renders correctly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add or configure Slack, or during the /setup flow. It copies/registers the adapter, installs the pinned dep, collects credentials, resolves your DM, and restarts.

say_en.text: Connect my Slack channel using Socket Mode.
Use webhook delivery instead — tell me what public URL to prepare.
say_en.note: Guides you through app creation and webhook settings.

say_en.text: Is Slack ready? Send a test message to my DM.
say_en.note: Resolves your member ID, restarts, then sends the greeting.
